automationNotes: Covers the Reset MFA section of https://www.contentstack.com/docs/developers/security/multi-factor-authentication. Requires MFA to be pre-enabled on the account. Automates up to the password entry step; QR code scanning, TOTP code entry, and backup-code handling are external and covered with warn actions. Any step that fails means the app does not match the documentation; the documentation must be updated.
